s: Two women, Ann Daniel and Caroline Hamilton, created history by reaching the North Pole recently, becoming the first female explorers to walk to both poles. They belong to
x: Ann Daniels and Caroline Hamilton are British (English) explorers; reaching the North Pole in June 2002 made them the first women to walk to both poles in all-women teams. They are not New Zealanders, Canadians or Australians.

x: The India–UK Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) was established on 13 January 2005, launched in New Delhi by Kamal Nath and Patricia Hewitt after the 2004 Joint Declaration; it meets annually. 13 January 2011 is wrong (the printed key and the old notes).

s: What made Friedrich Merz’s election as the 10th Chancellor of Germany on 6th May 2025 historically significant?
o: He is the first Christian Democratic Union (CDU) leader to become Chancellor
He is the youngest Chancellor in German history
He is the first Chancellor elected directly by popular vote
He was elected in the second round of Bundestag voting, a first since World War II
x: On 6 May 2025 Merz failed to get a majority in the first Bundestag ballot, the first time this had happened in post-war Germany, and won the second round with 325 votes. Several CDU leaders were Chancellor before him (Adenauer, Kohl, Merkel), he is not the youngest, and the Chancellor is elected by the Bundestag, not by popular vote.

s: Which Arab state has started first nuclear power plant?
x: The UAE's Barakah Nuclear Power Plant (Abu Dhabi) is the first nuclear power plant in the Arab world; it began operating in 2020 and supplies up to 25% of the UAE's electricity. Saudi Arabia, Egypt (El Dabaa, under construction) and Iraq have none operating.
